class CacheItem:
    """
    Represents a single item in the cache with its value, insertion time, and TTL.
    
    Attributes:
        value: The cached value
        insert_time: The time when the item was inserted
        ttl: Time to live in seconds (None means no expiry)
    """
    
    def __init__(self, value: Any, ttl: Optional[float] = None):
        """
        Initialize a CacheItem.
        
        Args:
            value: The value to cache
            ttl: Time to live in seconds. If None, the item never expires.
        """
        self.value = value
        self.insert_time = time.time()
        self.ttl = ttl
    
    def is_expired(self, now: Optional[float] = None) -> bool:
        """
        Check if this cache item has expired.
        
        Args:
            now: Current time (defaults to time.time())
            
        Returns:
            True if the item has expired, False otherwise
        """
        if self.ttl is None:
            return False
        if now is None:
            now = time.time()
        return (now - self.insert_time) > self.ttl
    
    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        """Return a string representation of the cache item."""
        ttl_str = f"{self.ttl}s" if self.ttl is not None else "never"
        return f"CacheItem(value={self.value!r}, ttl={ttl_str}, insert_time={self.insert_time})"
